label: Late-episode D2 after choosing a2 again following an unrewarded rare trial
explanation: Fires only at D2, only when this trial chose a2, and only in the last ~10 trials of the episode (ep_trial 90-99; 96% of mass, none before trial 80). The input reward was 0 (100% of mass), and the previous trial was an a2 trial that went rare to S1 and was unrewarded (prev_common == 0), or the previous trial falls outside the window (prev_common unknown). So it is a stay on a2 after rare-unrewarded, which is model-based behaviour, mostly when S2 is good. It never fires at D1/GO, after a reward, after a common previous transition, on a1 trials, or before trial 80. Magnitude: larger when the D2 state is S2 (common); reaching S1 (rare) gives weaker activations. It also lines up with a low model value (<5.22) and a strongly negative a1-a2 logit. All variables are observed at D2. Dev F1 0.75, mass recall 0.96. Precision of ~0.63 is limited by window-start trials whose true previous outcome is unknown, and by some matching trials that stay silent.
